During the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Information broker/Legends|information broker]] [[Switch]] led a '''criminal organization''' that was based in [[Deep Storage Bay V14]] on [[Sel Zonn Station]], an [[XQ2 Platform]] that [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal IV]]. In about [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], the [[Chevin/Legends|Chevin]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Ganga Lor]] led an attack on Bay V14, in an attempt to put Switch and his organization out of business.
